biotools.summary: Alevin-fry-atac is a tool for rapid and memory-frugal mapping of single-cell ATAC-seq data utilizing virtual colors for accurate genomic pseudoalignment. It is freely available under a BSD 3-clause license and integrated into piscem and simpleaf.
